topPRs.title: feat: add V800 devnet fallback JSON fixtures
topPRs.author: stevennevins
topPRs.body:
## Summary
- move the V800 upgrade and migration devnet chain addresses into sibling fallback `addresses.json` files
- wire both V800 example configs through `fallbackAddressesJsonPath`
- keep OPCM as an explicit `[addresses].OPCM` task TOML address loaded by the templates
- align V800 migrate validation with the devnet OPCM shape while keeping the migration test's in-fork V800 prerequisite upgrade

## Notes
Chain-specific addresses now use the built-in fallback JSON mechanism. OPCM remains an explicit task TOML address.

The CI example-task skip for `036-opcm-migrate-v800` remains scoped to the required pre-upgraded V800/Super Root chain state.

## Validation
- `forge fmt --check src/template/OPCMUpgradeV800.sol src/template/OPCMMigrateV800.sol test/integration/SuperRootUpgrade.t.sol test/integration/SuperRootMigrate.t.sol`
- `forge build`
- `forge test --match-contract SuperRootUpgradeTest -vvv`
- `forge test --match-contract SuperRootMigrateTest -vvv`
- `forge test --match-path test/registry/SuperchainAddressRegistry.t.sol -vvv`
- `just --justfile src/ci.just --summary`
- `just --justfile src/justfile --summary`

`forge fmt --check` repo-wide still fails on the existing `src/libraries/AccountAccessParser.sol` parser issue around line 777; touched Solidity files pass the formatter check above.

topPRs.title: Add interop-jnt-v2 V800 upgrade and migration tasks
topPRs.author: stevennevins
topPRs.body:
## Summary

- Add Sepolia task 076 for the interop-jnt-v2 OPCM V800 upgrade to SUPER_CANNON_KONA.
- Add Sepolia task 077 for the interop-jnt-v2 OPCM V800 migration to SUPER_CANNON_KONA.
- Include fallback devnet address artifacts for chains 420120102 and 420120103 because these chains are not in the public superchain registry.
- Mark both tasks DRAFT, NOT READY TO SIGN.

## Validation

- Compared every fallback address value against ethereum-optimism/devnets PR #323 at 783214f937aef1f1a3ef7e63f5e1459d58f82153, using cast to-check-sum-address for EIP-55 normalization.
- Verified every address string in both addresses.json files is EIP-55 checksummed.
- Verified both addresses.json files are valid JSON and byte-identical.
- Validated the migration config structure against test/tasks/example/sep/036-opcm-migrate-v800/config.toml.
- Ran git diff --check.

## Notes

- VALIDATION.md files intentionally keep domain/message hashes and final state changes as TODOs until simulation output is generated before signing.

topPRs.title: fix: v800 support upgrading permissioned to permissionless
topPRs.author: stevennevins
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Updates the V800 upgrade template so the configured starting respected game type is enabled even when it would otherwise be blocked by the default guard clauses. Also keeps `SUPER_PERMISSIONED_CANNON` enabled by default and adds integration coverage for both behaviors.

## Additional context

Validated with `forge test --match-contract SuperRootUpgradeTest`.

fixes https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20562
